digest.component_or_area: LLM structured output / JSON extraction pipeline
propositions: Current schema-filtered JSON extraction remains vulnerable to trailing schema-valid decoys and fence-wrapped quoted content, necessitating an explicit output channel via sentinel markers

Extraction logic must be refactored to wrap `_candidate_dicts` → `validate_to` → selection pipeline into a private `_select_and_validate` helper, then rewritten in `parse_structured` to prioritize complete marker blocks in reverse document order before falling back to markerless full-reply selection

Marker pairing must be deterministic and collision-proof: line-anchored recognition (markers alone on physical lines), left-to-right non-nested pairing (each `<<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>>` pairs with the next `<<<END>>>`), with block content extracted between marker lines

Bounded-retry prompt in `structured_run.py` must name the same markers as the first attempt, ensuring the fail-closed retry channel matches the directive instead of contradicting it with bare-JSON instructions

Test provider parity constraints must be updated to single-source the entire `schema_directive` output (not just the lead-in) and extract only the compact schema line, preserving the parity invariant that both prompted arms carry identical directives
Markerless replies must fall through byte-for-byte unchanged to the existing schema-filtered selection pipeline, guaranteeing no regression on legacy and non-compliant-model transcripts
